title: Replace logo with text-only 'Smileup' wordmark in TopBar and LandingPage

requirements.summary: Replace logo image with text-only 'Smileup' wordmark in TopBar using existing brand colors
acceptanceCriteria: No logo image is rendered in the TopBar
The TopBar displays 'Smileup' as styled text using the existing brand accent colors
The wordmark looks sharp and professional against the black page background
No broken image references remain in the TopBar component

file_operations.description: Remove any logo image element (such as references to generated/smileup-logo.dim_400x300.png or generated/vibeshare-logo.dim_256x256.png) and replace it with a text-only 'Smileup' wordmark. Apply a gradient or multi-color treatment using the existing brand accent colors (e.g., using Tailwind gradient utilities like bg-gradient-to-r from-primary to-secondary or similar existing color tokens) to ensure the wordmark contrasts well on the black background. Use a clean, professional typographic style with appropriate font weight and sizing.

requirements.summary: Replace logo image with text-only 'Smileup' wordmark in LandingPage matching TopBar style
acceptanceCriteria: No logo image is rendered on the LandingPage
The LandingPage displays 'Smileup' as styled text using the same brand colors as the TopBar wordmark
The wordmark is legible and professional on the black background
No broken image references remain in the LandingPage component

file_operations.description: Remove any logo image element (such as references to generated/smileup-logo.dim_400x300.png or generated/vibeshare-logo.dim_256x256.png) and replace it with a text-only 'Smileup' wordmark. Use the same gradient/color treatment and typographic style established in TopBar.tsx to ensure visual consistency. Ensure the wordmark reads clearly on the black background and maintains the same professional appearance.

requirements.summary: Replace splash screen logo with text-only 'Smileup' wordmark in App.tsx for consistency
acceptanceCriteria: The initialization splash screen shows 'Smileup' as styled text, not an image
The wordmark style is consistent with TopBar and LandingPage

file_operations.description: Locate the splash/logo screen shown during initialization and replace any logo image element with a text-only 'Smileup' wordmark. Apply the same gradient/color treatment and typographic style used in TopBar.tsx and LandingPage.tsx to maintain visual consistency across all loading and entry states.
